correctness.rationale: The ordinary matching complex is built from the thirty explicit icosahedral edges; independently enumerated its nonempty face vector (30,315,1400,2535,1482,125) and sparse finite-field simplicial boundary ranks (1,29,286,1114,1357,125) modulo 1,000,003, agreeing with the frozen code. Adjacent rank saturation forces all rational boundary ranks and H3 dimension exactly 64; this is not a naive modulus-to-Q inference. Independently enumerated all 120 graph automorphisms and signed simplex Lefschetz characters, grouped by A5 rotation orders 1,2,3,5 with traces (64,0,-2,-1) and antipodal coset (16,0,-2,1). Rational A5 character inner products, remembering that V6 rational is the Galois pair of 3-dimensional complex irreducibles, give the displayed integer multiplicities and plus/minus dimensions 40/24. The separate frozen verify_torsion.py source constructs F3 antipodal ± chain complexes; the published rank tables yield H4(F3) exactly one-dimensional in the minus eigenspace, consistent with UCT and known integral H4(Z)=0/H3 torsion Z/3. Naturality of UCT implies τ acts -1 on torsion, and perfectness of A5 forces trivial rotations. The integral homotopy type and torsion existence are prior same-object results, not recreated from finite rational ranks.
